parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable internet access. The default is false.
If set to true, the virtual node is assigned a public IP address.

parameters.name: ClusterDNS
parameters.description: The tags for the virtual node. You can specify a maximum of 20 tags.

parameters.name: ClusterDomain
parameters.description:
The IP addresses of the DNS servers. If `dnsPolicy=ClusterFirst` is set in an ECI pod, the pod uses these addresses for DNS.
You can specify multiple IP addresses. Separate them with commas.

parameters.name: CustomResources
parameters.description: The domain name of the cluster. After configuration, Kubelet configures all containers to search this domain name in addition to the host's search domain.

parameters.name: EipInstanceId
parameters.description: The KubeConfig of the Kubernetes cluster to which the virtual node connects. The value must be Base64-encoded.

parameters.name: EnablePublicNetwork
parameters.description: The ID of the Elastic IP Address.

parameters.name: KubeConfig
parameters.description:
The custom resources supported by the virtual node. If an ECI pod declares a corresponding custom resource in its request, the pod is scheduled to the virtual node.
The format is `resource name=resource count`. Use a comma to separate multiple resources.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: Ensures the idempotence of the request. The client generates a value for this parameter. You must make sure that the value is unique for each request. The value can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters long. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the vSwitch used by the virtual node and the ECI instances on the virtual node.
You can specify 1 to 10 vSwitches that belong to the same VPC.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: You can add up to 20 taints to the virtual node.

parameters.name: Taint
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable TLS bootstrapping. If this feature is enabled, the KubeConfig certificate is used for TLS bootstrapping. Valid values:

- true: Enabled

- false: Disabled

Default: false.

sub_parameters.name: Effect
sub_parameters.description:
The effect of the taint. Valid values:
\- NoSchedule: Pods cannot be scheduled to the tainted node.
\- NoExecute: Pods cannot be scheduled to the tainted node, and existing pods on the node are evicted.
\- PreferNoSchedule: Pods are preferentially not scheduled to the tainted node.

parameters.name: TlsBootstrapEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable TLS bootstrapping. If this parameter is enabled, use the KubeConfig certificate for TLS bootstrapping. Valid values:
\- true
\- false
Default value: false.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The name of the virtual node. The name must be 2 to 128 characters long and can contain lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: VirtualNodeName
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group. The virtual node and the ECI instances in the virtual node are added to this security group.
